args.subject: Group stay availability for 10 people in June
args.body:
Hello City Hub Tokyo team,

I'm organising a group stay for 10 people in June and would like to ask about your availability. Could you let me know which dates in June could accommodate our group, along with available room configurations, rates, and any group-booking conditions?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
